parameters.name: CalType
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query the new or legacy security score rules. If the value is **home_security_score**, the new security score rules are queried. Otherwise, the legacy security score rules are queried by default.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.
